entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Request Delegate Generator: [AsParameters] with service properties adds IAcceptsMetadata to a GET endpoint, so a catch-all endpoint takes the request (404) #70638

  • Minimal API validation returns 500 instead of 400 in the webapiaot template (HttpValidationProblemDetails missing from JSON metadata) #70625

Closed

  • Blazor Web App (InteractiveWebAssembly): Page title flashes to domain name during hydration #68346
    .NET 12 Planning

    Backlog
